subtasks.description: Define supported private CPU/GPU topologies, capacity envelope, local IdP and storage choices.
Build signed offline images/model bundles with pinned hashes, licenses and required runtime dependencies.
Add preflight for driver/VRAM/disk/ports/TLS, local model readiness and no-internet configuration.
Implement signed offline entitlements, expiry/grace/read-export behavior and operator-visible counters.
Package install, upgrade, backup/restore, rollback and sanitized support-bundle commands/runbooks.
Test install and representative processing/export/deletion with all outbound network access denied.
Rehearse upgrade from the prior supported version with real fixture data, failed migration recovery and customer-admin handoff.
